info.title: Transmitly API
info.description: Durable email acceptance, delivery events and inbound routing. Acceptance (202) means committed to Postgres; delivered_to_mx means the remote MX accepted the message, not inbox placement.

from.description: Display name optional, e.g. 'Notify <notify@mail.acme.com>'. Domain must be verified.

reply_to.description: Optional Reply-To address, display name allowed. Takes precedence over a Reply-To header. Must be a valid email address.

headers.description: Additional headers. From, To, Subject, Date, Message-ID and Reply-To are managed by the API.

template_id.description: Resolve subject/html/text from a workspace template

test_mode.description: Accept and record the message without attempting SMTP delivery

address.description: Address on a verified workspace domain

variant_b_subject.description: Optional B variant subject; empty falls back to A

winner_enabled.description: Requires a B variant and matching tracking

segment_id.description: Target a saved segment; overrides audience_id

topic.description: Optional preference topic; contacts opted out of it are excluded

confirmation_from.description: Verified sender for the confirmation email

trigger_url.description: Substring match for tracked click URLs; empty matches any click

post.description: Durably accepts a message. Returns 202 only after the message, deliveries, idempotency key and outbox event commit.
